purpose: Additively link the two distinct H2B-B1 execution defects WITHOUT rewriting or deleting the original defect artifact, and without conflating them.

defects.summary: Inherited TRAINING_START_BASENAME / TRAINING_COMPLETION_BASENAME constants omitted the experiment id, so successive lineage runs overwrote the same two audit files.

The runner executed the correct SoftTargetFocalBCE objective, but the resume contract, checkpoint metadata and start/completion audits still carried stale Phase-13 CenterNet fields loss_alpha=2.0 / loss_beta=4.0 and declared protocol_identity 'R2 + R2A_LOSS_BINDING' as the ACTIVE identity.
defects.scientific_impact: NONE on executed mathematics; MATERIAL on provenance / resume-contract correctness.
defects.resolution: Stale objective identity removed and replaced with the H2B objective identity; pre-fix execution invalidated, archived and relaunched from scratch.

relationship.both_share_a_root_cause_family: H2B runner derived from the Phase-13/H2A lineage without re-labelling inherited identity constants.
